name: Voxel Backface Culling and Internal Face Masking
definition: A technique to reject invisible faces in voxel rendering by determining front/back orientation in projection space and masking faces shared between neighboring voxels.
summary: Voxel Backface Culling and Internal Face Masking rejects invisible faces in voxel rendering by operating directly on voxel primitives in the geometry shader stage, using projection-space orientation and bitmasks to eliminate internal geometry without relying on mesh connectivity or external depth buffers.
